name: codex-hooks
description: Schema-first operating layer for Codex hooks: policy, state, diagnostics, and verified guardrails.

scripts.policy:smoke: node src/adapters/cli.mjs policy verify-command --event pre-tool-use --command "sed -n '1,20p' file 2>/dev/null" --expect allow && node src/adapters/cli.mjs policy verify-command --event pre-tool-use --command "printf 'x' 2>/dev/null" --expect allow && node src/adapters/cli.mjs policy verify-command --event pre-tool-use --command "rm -rf /tmp/codex-hooks-target" --expect block
scripts.verify: npm run check:handbook && npm run check:stale && npm run policy:check && npm test && npm run smoke
